scope: Actual post-master instrumental mix; original drums+bass+other recombined by the app. Melody guide excluded in both comparisons.
caveats: Relative band powers are level-normalized; dynamics and level are separate measurements.
Stem bleed is not instrument ground truth. Recombining three stems can retain vocal leakage and separation artifacts.
REC/seek times have small encoding and control delays; this is not sample-aligned waveform fidelity.
A quiet interval can be musical: check against the original before calling it a dropout.
No listening-quality score, pitch/chord accuracy claim, or physical iPhone measurement.

Empty transcription bars are not proof of acoustic silence: detector omissions remain. Electric Sheep bar 52 has no guitar row despite audible source accompaniment; this change does not recover it or invent notes.
This deliberately targets four sparse/gap windows, not a representative seven-song quality score. Human Fly and Electric Sheep balance discrepancies are approximately unchanged/slightly higher.
Sister accompaniment still differs in level (about 5 dB in these windows), high-frequency detail and voicing; removing fallback does not certify complete reproduction.

conditions.recording: Actual UI START, seek, 1.8 s settle, 10 s REC, post-master 48 kHz stereo PCM16
